method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); one date module, one module of exported questions with the s 1056A(1) duty as a regulative rule run by EVALTRACE inside a question that takes only plain facts, one case file; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate. Added beside baseline-2026-10 and naive-2026-10, which are untouched.
edition_encoded: Corporations Act 2001, Compilation No. 149, compilation date 19 September 2026, includes amendments to Act No. 87, 2026 (register id C2026C00432), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00818.txt; Corporations Regulations 2001 not deposited (what they prescribe is asked as a fact)
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the individual who brings, or may bring, a claim under the Act's consumer and whistleblower provisions: the retail client given personal advice, the investor misled or kept uninformed, the retail client who wants to return a product in the cooling-off period, the superannuation member or person with an interest in a death benefit who complains to AFCA, and the eligible whistleblower who suffers detriment (fsc-claimant.l4)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run fsc-dates.l4 ; l4 run fsc-claimant.l4 ; l4 run fsc-cases.l4
checks.result: 199 assertions written, 199 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read; a deliberately wrong assertion was run once in a scratch file (since deleted) and showed as DiagnosticSeverity_Error, assertion failed. Expected values worked by hand from the text and the calendar.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets in Chapter 7 financial services, Part 7.7A best interests, Part 7.10A AFCA, continuous disclosure, s 1041H, s 1317HA and Part 9.4AAA whistleblowers. In: Part 7.6 Division 6 (ss 917A-917F); Part 7.7A Division 2 (ss 961, 961B, 961F, 961G, 961H, 961J, 961M, 961P); Part 7.9 Division 5 cooling-off (ss 1019A, 1019B); ss 1041H, 1041I; s 674A(2)-(4) with ss 1317E(3) (the table), 1317HA, 1317K; Part 7.10A ss 1051(2)(d), (4)(e), 1053, 1053A, 1053B, 1055, 1056, 1056A, 1057; Part 9.4AAA ss 1317AA, 1317AAA, 1317AAB, 1317AAC, 1317AAD, 1317AADA, 1317AAE, 1317AB, 1317AD, 1317ADA, 1317AE, 1317AH. Out: Part 7.7A Divisions 3 to 5 (ongoing fees, conflicted remuneration), ss 953B, 953C, 1022B (defective FSG, SOA, PDS), ss 1041E-1041G, Division 2A proportionate liability and s 1044B, ss 674, 675, 675A, 1317S, AFCA machinery (Divisions 1, 2, 4 of Part 7.10A, ss 1054-1054C, 1055A-1055D, 1057A, 1057B, 1058), Part 7.10B (CSLR), ss 1317AC, 1317AF, 1317AG, 1317AI, 1317AJ, the retail client and personal advice definitions (asked as facts), penalties. Reasons in NOTES.md.
